rule: GOAL: Match the four empty slots to the colored target sequence shown at the top. CONTROLS: Click a color button to select it, then click an empty slot to place that color. RULE: Each color button is single-use; the slot only fills if the selected color matches the target. TRAP: Believing the palette order dictates placement; the top row, not the bottom buttons, sets the required sequence.

GOAL: Click three specific spots to finish the level. CONTROLS: Single clicks on colored blocks or wall gaps to trigger changes. RULE: Only interactive objects respond; clicking empty space wastes time. TRAP: Assuming every visible item is clickable; the arrow and some blocks were decoys.

GOAL: Guide the falling block into the yellow container's notch. CONTROLS: Arrows move the blue platform; Space releases the block. RULE: The block bounces off the platform, changing direction based on impact point. TRAP: Believing the block falls straight down regardless of platform position wastes moves and misses the target.

GOAL: Move the token to the gray target square. CONTROLS: Click a dot on the track to jump the token to that spot. RULE: The token can only jump to dots within three hops of its current position. TRAP: Thinking you could click any dot on the track, regardless of distance, wastes actions on failed moves.

GOAL: Move both dots to align with their respective plus symbols. CONTROLS: Click the bottom yellow cell to increase vertical position; click the green cell to increase horizontal position. RULE: Each click moves a dot exactly three units toward the target. TRAP: Assuming the bar’s edge must touch the plus; only the dot’s center needs to land on the target.

GOAL: Align the plug’s tab with the socket’s notch by shifting the plug horizontally. CONTROLS: Top switches move the plug left or right; bottom switches adjust vertical alignment; the mouse button executes the movement. RULE: Each active switch corresponds to a single unit of distance in its respective direction. TRAP: Assuming switches control the socket; they actually move the plug, so invert your mental model of the target position.

GOAL: Guide the eye to the exit by moving two steps at a time. CONTROLS: Arrows slide the eye two blocks in that direction. RULE: You must land on a white block; gray blocks are just path. TRAP: Assuming you can move into any open space, ignoring the landing color constraint.

GOAL: Arrange colored blocks in two boxes to match a hidden sequence. CONTROLS: Click source color then target slot to move; Space confirms solution. RULE: The green frame acts as a sequence marker, splitting the input list between the two containers. TRAP: Assuming a simple top-down reading order ignores the frame's role as a structural divider.

GOAL: Expand the middle chamber to allow the group to move right. CONTROLS: Click the blue button below the left wall to pump space. RULE: Each click transfers four columns of open space from the top chamber to the middle chamber. TRAP: Believing white space is static; it acts like a fluid that moves between chambers when pumped.

GOAL: Place seven colors into nested slots to match the top sequence. CONTROLS: Click a palette color, then click a slot; press space to submit. RULE: Nested boxes flatten into one line in left-to-right reading order. TRAP: Assuming slot counts equal box borders; hidden nested slots add up to match the full sequence length.

GOAL: Place six colored blocks and one green plug into a nested structure to match a seven-item sequence. CONTROLS: Click a color button to select it, then click a specific slot in the red or green box to place it. Press space to submit. RULE: The green box expands into the red box at the plug's position, shifting all subsequent red slots down the sequence. TRAP: Assuming the pre-filled green item is just decoration. It counts as a sequence item, forcing the plug into the third red slot.

GOAL: Shrink the key tip by matching the target pattern, then slide it left into the head slot. CONTROLS: Arrows move the key tip; clicking cycles cell colors between White, Neutral, and Gray. RULE: Clicking a White cell turns it Neutral, then Gray, where Gray matches the target shape. TRAP: Assuming a single click fixes a cell; the first click only changes state, requiring a second to clear it.

GOAL: Place three cores into the three container slots to clear the level. CONTROLS: Arrows move the player; Space drops the held core into the current top-block cell. RULE: Dropping converts the player's top block into a socket at their current position. TRAP: Believing the drop requires facing the target slot; facing direction is irrelevant for dropping.

GOAL: Arrange six colored tiles and two blue frames to form a flat sequence where two identical three-tile patterns appear. CONTROLS: Click a palette item then a grid slot to place it; press Space to verify the solution. RULE: Each blue frame expands into the three tiles placed inside the blue box, creating repeated patterns in the final row. TRAP: Assuming each expansion needs unique tiles; realizing the blue box contents are shared saved crucial time.

GOAL: Guide the four-wide tip upward through the shaft into the head’s open interior. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the tip; mouse clicks adjust the side panel pattern. RULE: Matching the side panel pattern retracts the charcoal collar blocks, clearing the path upward. TRAP: The tip fits the shaft width, so do not try to shrink it; focus on unlocking the collar first.

GOAL: Arrange nested color frames to match a hidden target sequence. CONTROLS: Click palette items to fill empty board slots. RULE: Flatten the tree by reading each sub-box from left to right, top to bottom. TRAP: Assuming the red box holds loose tiles instead of holding the three colored sub-boxes.

GOAL: Arrange nested colored boxes to produce the specific target sequence of colors. CONTROLS: Click buttons to place items into slots; press space to submit the solution. RULE: A frame placed in a slot displays the contents of the box matching the frame's color. TRAP: Assuming all boxes are independent; nesting a frame inside another box creates a deeper dependency chain.

GOAL: Align each column’s symbol to its target. CONTROLS: Left/right moves the cursor; Up cycles the current column’s symbol. RULE: Press Up repeatedly until the displayed symbol matches the target for that column. TRAP: Pressing Up a fixed number of times instead of checking the match after every single press.

GOAL: Raise three pistons to specific target heights by moving air between five connected chambers. CONTROLS: Click buttons to pump air, shifting volume from one chamber to another while respecting connection paths. RULE: Air flows only through open pipes; moving air raises one piston but lowers its source, requiring balanced transfers. TRAP: Assuming all chambers connect freely; isolated sections require specific intermediate pumps to move air, not direct clicks.

GOAL: Rotate seven symbol slots until each matches the target shape, regardless of orientation. CONTROLS: Arrows move the cursor; UP rotates the current slot. RULE: The game checks for rotational matches, so any rotation of the target shape counts as correct. TRAP: Believing you must align the symbol to the exact upright target position; this wastes moves when a rotated match already exists.

GOAL: Parse the yellow glyph sequence to determine the correct blue tile arrangement. CONTROLS: Arrows cycle blue tile rotations; UP adjusts the current slot’s pattern. RULE: Each yellow glyph maps to a specific blue shape; the total blue length must equal seven. TRAP: Assuming a single glyph match is unique; identical shapes create parsing ambiguity that requires strict length validation.

GOAL: Fit four colored shapes into specific slots by adjusting their size and position to clear a path. CONTROLS: Click panel buttons to grow or shrink each shape horizontally or vertically. RULE: Shapes cannot overlap; they must occupy only their designated empty space without blocking others. TRAP: Assuming you can move shapes independently; pushing one shape often shifts adjacent ones, requiring careful order.

GOAL: Align two colored crosses by moving each to a specific grid intersection. CONTROLS: Arrow keys shift the selected color; Spacebar switches between colors. RULE: Selecting a color allows you to move its entire shape as one unit. TRAP: Moving both shapes simultaneously or forgetting to switch colors before moving.

GOAL: Reach the exit safely while avoiding the pursuing chaser. CONTROLS: Arrows move the player two tiles, stopping early if blocked. RULE: The chaser attacks if you end your move within two tiles. TRAP: Assuming the chaser only moves when you are adjacent; it charges from a distance.

GOAL: Merge two yellow tokens into a single four-by-four block to clear the level. CONTROLS: Clicking a spot moves the nearest token to that location. RULE: If a click lands within reach of two same-color tokens, they merge instead of conflicting. TRAP: Assuming any double-reach causes an error; different colors conflict, but matching colors combine.

GOAL: Move three colored shapes to align with matching dots. CONTROLS: Arrows move the selected shape; Space switches to the next color. RULE: Each shape must cover its specific colored dots completely. TRAP: Assuming Space cycles colors randomly; it actually follows a fixed order, so plan your sequence carefully.

GOAL: Rotate the ring until the yellow block aligns with the fixed bracket. CONTROLS: Click the red arrow to shift the ring counter-clockwise, moving blocks toward the bracket. RULE: Only the block at the bracket’s position counts; other colors are irrelevant. TRAP: Assuming all colors needed sorting; only the yellow block’s position matters for success.

GOAL: Clear the board by removing all pegs through jumping. CONTROLS: Click a peg to select it, then click a highlighted spot to jump over an adjacent peg into that empty space. RULE: Every jump must land in an empty spot directly beyond the peg being jumped over. TRAP: Assuming any highlighted spot is valid; verify the landing spot is truly empty, not just a potential target.

GOAL: Guide three shapes to specific spots to cover marked dots. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the selected shape; Space switches to the next shape. RULE: Only the shape under the cursor moves, so position the cursor carefully before pressing arrows. TRAP: Assuming all shapes move simultaneously wastes turns; you must select each one individually to adjust its position.

GOAL: You fixed a mismatched panel by clicking its blocks until their colors matched the small key. CONTROLS: You clicked grid blocks to toggle their colors between blue and red. RULE: The tiny key showed which color belonged where; green meant blue, white meant red. TRAP: Assuming the key was static when it actually defined the target pattern for the highlighted square.

GOAL: Merge the two colored blocks into a single unit. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move both blocks simultaneously; left mirrors right. RULE: The blocks collide and combine when they occupy the same cell. TRAP: Assuming independent movement wastes turns; every input affects both blocks at once.

GOAL: Guide the sliding block into the upper chamber. CONTROLS: Arrows move the block one step. RULE: The block slides until it hits a wall or obstacle. TRAP: Thinking the top panel was a solid barrier; it was actually the open target zone.

GOAL: Guide the white diamond to the ring by moving the gray one. CONTROLS: Click empty space to move the white diamond; click the gray diamond to swap positions. RULE: The gray diamond acts as a pivot; swapping allows the white diamond to bypass obstacles. TRAP: Believing the white diamond must travel the entire path; it can teleport via swaps.

ESTROLISHED: The arm retracts to column 16 and extends to 22. Moving the head vertically shifts the arm's active row. Blocks attached to the tip move with it; unattached blocks are pushed by the arm's side. FAILED: Moving the head down while the arm was extended trapped a block. Moving up with an extended arm caused a collision with a stationary block. GOAL IS NOT: Simply pushing all blocks to the right edge or aligning them in a single column without vertical separation. CONTROLS: LEFT retracts the arm. RIGHT extends the arm. UP and DOWN move the head, shifting the arm's vertical position to

GOAL: Match the board to the overlapping mini-patterns by turning specific tiles orange. CONTROLS: Clicking a tile toggles its color between blue and orange. RULE: White symbols in the diagrams mean orange tiles; gray means blue. TRAP: Assuming the diagrams show independent halves rather than one continuous overlapping map.

GOAL: Place two yellow pieces into their matching bracket slots. CONTROLS: Red arrows shift rows right; green arrows shift rows left. RULE: Only rows containing target cells affect the solution; ignore others. TRAP: Assuming all yellow pieces must move to the same bracket.

GOAL: Change all blocks to orange to match the hidden target pattern. CONTROLS: Click a block to toggle its color between red and orange. RULE: The four number clues in the corners dictate the specific color required for each block. TRAP: Assuming the initial red state was correct; actually, most blocks started wrong and needed toggling.

GOAL: Move the yellow marker to the left bracket and the orange marker to the right bracket. CONTROLS: Red and green buttons rotate the left and right rings in opposite directions. RULE: The rings are linked, so turning one side affects the shared top cell and shifts both colors. TRAP: Assuming the right ring rotates in the same direction as the left wastes moves; test one click to confirm orientation first.

GOAL: Move the orange plus away to reveal the hidden X shape underneath. CONTROLS: Arrow keys moved the selected shape; Space switched selection between the plus and the X. RULE: The plus center pixel sits directly on top of the X, hiding it until the plus moves. TRAP: Believing the X was gone; it was merely covered by the plus’s center pixel until you shifted the plus.

GOAL: Paint a grid of blue blocks to match a target pattern of red and orange squares. CONTROLS: Click any block to cycle its color from blue to red to orange. RULE: Red targets need one click; orange targets need two clicks to advance past red. TRAP: Assuming one click paints any color directly, causing orange cells to remain red and requiring extra corrections.

ESTABLISHED: Arrows move the selected eye three cells; clicks select eyes. Eyes push each other when moving into occupied spaces. FAILED: Placing one eye in a frame, clicking walls, and achieving vertical adjacency all produced no change. GOAL IS NOT: Simply filling a single frame, clicking the purple wall, or making the eyes touch vertically. CONTROLS: Click to select an eye. Arrow keys move the selected eye three grid spaces, pushing other eyes if blocked.

ESTABLISHED: The red snake head blocks the left passage; its body extends right then up to a top-right blob. Gray blocks appear at the ring's start after resetting. FAILED: Moving down in state B hits an invisible wall; SPACE resets the ring's position and appears to restart the level. GOAL IS NOT: Simply navigating the ring to the red snake's head or treating the red trail as a solid wall to path around. CONTROLS: Arrows move the ring; SPACE switches states but resets the ring's position to the start.

GOAL: Navigate a block through obstacles to reach a target while managing limited energy. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the block one grid space per press. RULE: Passing through specific rings instantly refills the energy bar to maximum. TRAP: Believing every action consumes energy equally; blocked moves do not drain the bar.

GOAL: Deliver an eye into the right-side frame interior. CONTROLS: Arrows move or knock eyes; clicks select them. RULE: Knocked eyes slide through purple walls, ignoring barriers. TRAP: Assuming purple walls block all movement wastes time.

GOAL: Rotate horizontal rows to place Yellow and Orange tokens at specific board edges. CONTROLS: Clicking a row shifts all tiles one step right, with tiles exiting the right edge wrapping to the left. RULE: The four horizontal rows form a single continuous loop, so shifting one row affects the next row's starting position. TRAP: Assuming each row wraps to itself caused failed alignments, as the right end connects to the opposite row's left end.

GOAL: Align the plug’s red prongs with the matching pins to complete the circuit. CONTROLS: Arrow keys slide the plug across the grid; Space rotates it clockwise. RULE: The plug moves in three-cell jumps, so alignment depends on matching the grid’s modulo spacing. TRAP: Assuming free movement led to wasted moves; you must calculate jump parity to hit the target.

GOAL: Transform blue shapes into yellow ones by passing them through a hidden pink stage. CONTROLS: Arrows move the selection cursor to choose which shape to transform. RULE: Each blue shape maps to a specific pink shape, which then maps to a final yellow shape. TRAP: Assuming a direct blue-to-yellow conversion exists; you must identify the intermediate pink pattern to find the correct output.

GOAL: Move the green dot to the yellow target. CONTROLS: Arrows move the dot; clicking colored pods toggles block shapes. RULE: The dot passes through red bars but stops on solid blue blocks. TRAP: Assuming all colored shapes are solid; red bars are actually passable paths.

GOAL: Align the black template with the yellow target piece. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the active shape across the grid. RULE: Yellow pieces are the destination; move shapes to cover them. TRAP: Assuming the charcoal shape was the goal; it was just a decoy.

GOAL: Move the black shape to the target zone using the mirror's reflection. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the mirror; SPACE pinned the shape to the mirror line. RULE: The reflection only moves when the shape is pinned by the mirror's dots. TRAP: Believing arrows moved the shape directly wasted time before pinning it first.

GOAL: Guide the green dot to the yellow target within a shrinking time budget. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the dot; the timer bar depletes with every action. RULE: The timer refills significantly upon completing objectives, rewarding quick progress. TRAP: Mistaking the timer for a permanent loss condition led to panic over long paths.

GOAL: Clear the grid in eight clicks. CONTROLS: Click cells to toggle states. RULE: Inverse mapping reveals the correct target cells. TRAP: Assuming visual symmetry matches logical inverse operations.

GOAL: Rotate eight tiles to match the fixed pattern on the bottom row. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the cursor between tiles; spacebar rotates the selected tile. RULE: Only rotational alignment counts; mirrored orientations are rejected, so check direction carefully. TRAP: Assuming adjacent tiles require complex navigation; since they are in a fixed cycle, moving in one direction is always faster than reversing.

GOAL: Align two light sources with their matching yellow targets by moving the mirror line and the sources. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the selected object; Space switches selection between the mirror line and the light sources. RULE: The mirror reflects light vertically; moving the line up or down shifts the reflection path, while moving sources adjusts their direct beam. TRAP: Assuming the mirror moves sources directly; you must move the sources themselves to align reflections, not just adjust the mirror position.

ESTABLISHED: A linear five-state chain exists where vertical movement cycles through positions, preventing the container from ever sitting directly below the canvas center. FAILED: Vertical movement alone cannot reposition the container to the optimal pouring angle, and horizontal movement from the current state remains unverified. GOAL IS NOT: Simply pouring the selected color from any vertical position to fill the canvas, as the fixed geometry blocks direct central access. CONTROLS: Arrow keys shift the container along the fixed chain; Space pours the currently selected color onto the canvas

ESTABLISHED: The boat rises at core 34-36, entering chamber E. The pink object sits at cols 20-22, rows 37-39. FAILED: Moving right to core 29-31 did not trigger a rise. Moving left to core 27-29 did not collect the pink. GOAL IS NOT: The pink object is not a switch to raise water levels. CONTROLS: Right moves shift the boat east. Left moves shift the boat west. Clicking activates the current state.

GOAL: Guide the boat through cleared water to collect the pink target. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the boat; clicking clears obstacles to create a path. RULE: The boat only floats in cleared water and sinks in solid blocks. TRAP: Assuming partial water overlap lifts the boat; full clearance of the boat's width is required.

GOAL: Fill the bottom half purple and the top half white. CONTROLS: Space pours paint at your location; arrow keys move between pouring spots. RULE: Each spot paints only the five rows directly next to it. TRAP: Assuming any spot paints the whole canvas wastes turns; you must visit the specific spot adjacent to the target rows.

GOAL: Move the piston from the left chamber to the right by balancing liquid levels. CONTROLS: Click buttons to pump liquid between chambers; click the orange window to transfer the piston. RULE: A button on a wall pushes liquid into the chamber on that same side. TRAP: Assuming the left button fills the right chamber wastes moves; it actually drains the right side into the left.

GOAL: Rotate the blue piece to face left, then shift it up to bridge the middle pins. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the piece; clicks selected it; Space rotated it clockwise. RULE: Three clockwise presses equal one counter-clockwise turn, aligning tips with the target. TRAP: Assuming the piece was already oriented correctly caused wasted movement before fixing the rotation.

GOAL: Paint specific grid sections using liquid pours. CONTROLS: Arrows move the container; clicks select colors; space pours. RULE: Pour order matters: fill the wide white area first, then the narrow orange triangle. TRAP: Assuming any color order works causes errors; pouring orange first gets erased by the subsequent white fill.

GOAL: Align three yellow tokens into their matching bracket slots using block rotations. CONTROLS: Clicking arrows rotates specific star-shaped clusters of cells around central hubs. RULE: Every click performs a strict, reversible permutation of the tokens within that cluster. TRAP: Assuming grid cells are adjacent; they are spaced three units apart, so neighbors are not touching.

GOAL: Align the U, bar, and mirror line to perfectly cover the yellow target shapes. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active shape; Space switches the active shape to the next one in the cycle. RULE: Shapes must be moved in the exact order of the Space cycle to avoid wasting moves. TRAP: Assuming shapes can be moved in any order; ignoring the pin cycle forces extra Space presses.

GOAL: Guide the piece to the target blob. CONTROLS: Click to move the piece toward that spot. RULE: The piece moves only within its maximum reach per click. TRAP: Assuming you can move any distance to the target in one click.

GOAL: Rotate the grid to align matching colors in contiguous blocks. CONTROLS: Arrow keys shift the board; the G button rotates the current configuration. RULE: A level is solved when all same-colored tiles form single, unbroken regions. TRAP: Assuming vertical and horizontal shifts are simple inverses that cancel out when separated by a rotation.

GOAL: Navigate to the exit without being caught. CONTROLS: Arrows move two spaces in a direction. RULE: Enemies lunge two spaces if you land directly in front of them. TRAP: Assuming you can safely land on an enemy's cell if another enemy threatens it.

GOAL: Fill the canvas with three colored regions using a sliding device. CONTROLS: Arrows move the device; keys select colors; Space pours ink. RULE: Each container pours only into its specific geometric zone. TRAP: Forgetting the device shifts position with each container, requiring re-aiming.

GOAL: Align piston widths and swap their positions between two adjacent zones. CONTROLS: Click side buttons to adjust individual piston widths; click center windows to move pistons across boundaries. RULE: Equalizing widths allows pistons to cross a window, but clicking a window with two adjacent pistons swaps their positions simultaneously. TRAP: Assuming each window click moves only one piston caused redundant actions; one click swaps both, so do not click twice.

GOAL: Fill the canvas by routing a cursor through six nodes to pour colors in specific regions. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the cursor between nodes; number keys select paint; spacebar pours from the current node. RULE: Each node pours a distinct geometric half-plane, like a diagonal split or vertical slice, defined by its position. TRAP: Assuming the cursor path is linear; it actually forms a hexagonal loop where left and right moves often reverse each other.

GOAL: Route the orange chain to its target ring while keeping the purple chain stable. CONTROLS: Click a chain handle to move it; click a ring to shift the active chain phase. RULE: Only the active chain’s handles move when you click; inactive chains stay fixed. TRAP: Assuming all chains move simultaneously; you must isolate the orange chain first.

GOAL: Align the source image and both mirror lines to cover all yellow blocks. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active element; Space cycles focus between the source, vertical line, and horizontal line. RULE: The source and mirrors must align with the 180-degree symmetry of the target shape. TRAP: Assuming Space cycles linearly; it actually loops, requiring you to press it multiple times to reach the specific element you need to adjust.

GOAL: Guide the green dot to the yellow target by activating hidden circuits. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the dot; clicks activate podiums. RULE: Stepping on solid purple unlocks its switch; clicking it turns checkered paths solid. TRAP: Clicking the switch while standing on the purple piece causes failure; move off first.

GOAL: Guide two colored blobs to their matching rings by moving them across the board. CONTROLS: Clicking empty black space moves the nearest blob directly to that spot. RULE: A blob always travels to the clicked location, regardless of other obstacles or paths. TRAP: Believing you must click adjacent to the blob; distant clicks work just as well.

GOAL: Clear the level by positioning the purple block onto the gray pin while keeping the yellow block aligned to prevent the pin from breaking prematurely. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the selected block, Space rotates it, and clicking a block selects it as the active piece. RULE: The gray pin remains stable only when supported by the yellow block, so the yellow must not move down before the purple secures the pin. TRAP: Assuming the yellow block can be moved down early to clear space, which causes the gray pin to break and fails the level.

GOAL: Guide a white token to form three target blobs. CONTROLS: Click moves the token; clicking a slot swaps it with the token. RULE: The blob always forms at the midpoint of the token and the slot. TRAP: Assuming clicks alone position the blob; you must swap to place the slot anchor correctly.

GOAL: Fill the right chamber to 24 units to push the piston to the far end. CONTROLS: Bottom buttons moved liquid between chambers; window buttons triggered the piston when aligned. RULE: The piston only moved when the liquid surface exactly touched the window’s edge. TRAP: Thinking you could move the piston from any liquid level wasted time waiting for perfect alignment.

GOAL: Assemble the spiral, vertical, and horizontal blocks into the central target. CONTROLS: Arrows move the selected piece; Space rotates it; Clicks select specific pieces. RULE: Pieces pass through each other, so you must align them by pinning the top layer last. TRAP: Assuming pieces block movement like walls cost time; they overlap freely, allowing direct paths.

GOAL: Turn the diamond red and reach the target marker. CONTROLS: Arrows move the character; Space selects or confirms actions. RULE: Selecting the correct tool changes the diamond’s color instantly. TRAP: The progress bar does not drop one unit per move; ignore its scale and focus on action count.

GOAL: Guide the avatar to the orange block without touching it. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the avatar two spaces in the chosen direction. RULE: The orange block slides one space along its track every time you move. TRAP: Believing you can wait for the block to pass; you must land exactly where it was not.

GOAL: Move the white piece to swap with a chain handle, then guide the new chain’s blob to absorb two specific tokens. CONTROLS: Click empty cells to move the white piece; clicking occupied cells does nothing. RULE: The click target must be free in the current board state, not just the destination. TRAP: Assuming the white piece’s own current footprint blocks the move; it only blocks if the click cell is occupied before the swap.

GOAL: Paint the canvas using overlapping pours to reveal a hidden red block. CONTROLS: Arrows move the brush between paint stations; clicks select tools or apply paint. RULE: Apply paints in a strict sequence so later layers correctly mask earlier ones. TRAP: Re-pouring orange early forces extra green fixes, wasting moves compared to the blue-green-orange order.

GOAL: Merge two squares into one pair and guide it through the bottom hazard row to exit. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move all squares simultaneously; successful merging creates a single immune unit. RULE: Only the merged pair survives the deadly spikes, allowing it to pass through the exit gate. TRAP: Assuming hazards are harmless or that merging alone wins; singles die on spikes, and exit requires movement.

GOAL: Match the HUD glyph's color and pattern to the chamber to unlock the exit. CONTROLS: Arrows move the block; covering the chip toggles the HUD color. RULE: The chamber only opens when both the pattern and color match the HUD exactly. TRAP: Assuming the chip was a static obstacle; it is actually a switch that changes the HUD color.

ESTABLISHED: The gray chamber exists at the intended destination, but teleporting there fails despite the path appearing clear. FAILED: Two right moves followed by three clicks; the tip did not transport to the chamber. GOAL IS NOT: Simply placing the tip over any gray area is insufficient if specific alignment or distance rules are unmet. CONTROLS: Right moves shift the tip horizontally; clicks attempt the teleport action.

ESTABLISHED: Blue grows push the red snake left by three columns per action. Seven grows clear the red from the sky’s path. FAILED: Assuming fewer than seven pushes suffices. Ignoring the red’s overlap with the sky’s starting zone. GOAL IS NOT: Moving the red to the far left edge. It only needs to clear column seven. CONTROLS: Blue grow shifts red left. Sky grow extends right to cover the target.

GOAL: Deliver five scattered sockets to their matching wall slots before the timer expires. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player; Space picks up or places a socket at the current location. RULE: The orange robot autonomously retrieves the nearest available socket, so you must manually handle the farthest ones. TRAP: Assuming you must deliver every socket personally wastes time; let the robot handle the closer targets while you grab the distant ones.

GOAL: Move four distinct rectangular blocks into their matching empty frames. CONTROLS: Arrows slide the selected block one step; clicks select a block. RULE: Blocks stop only when hitting a wall or another block, not mid-grid. TRAP: Assuming blocks stop after one arrow press; they actually slide until obstructed.

ESTABLISHED: The standard 27-cell board matches the legend patterns exactly in both phases, yet neither triggers a win. FAILED: Filling the main grid to match Phase A or Phase B legends, and verifying all 27 cells against the checker. GOAL IS NOT: Matching the visible legend patterns on the 27 standard cells, as both exact matches were rejected. CONTROLS: Selecting cells to rotate or paint colors, and submitting the current board state to test against the hidden target.

ESTABLISHED: The green bar drains per action, not per launch frame. The water tank is finite and depletes with use. FAILED: Launching when the tank is empty or the path is blocked causes instant death. GOAL IS NOT: Surviving indefinitely; the objective is not merely preventing the bar from hitting zero. CONTROLS: SPACE launches water if resources allow. MOUSE adjusts aim. Actions consume budget.

GOAL: Expand the frame to target size, then move it clear of obstacles to the goal. CONTROLS: Arrows move the frame; pressing into a wall expands the frame instead of moving. RULE: Expansion happens when movement is blocked, growing the frame while shrinking the opposite dimension. TRAP: Assuming expansion direction is fixed; it can shift, requiring verification of frame position after each block.

GOAL: Route three fluid streams to fill their respective target notches without any leaks. CONTROLS: Arrow keys slide colored blocks horizontally; mouse clicks swap adjacent pieces; spacebar launches the water flow. RULE: Fluids split at junctions and rise only through open vertical paths, filling notches if the route is clear. TRAP: Assuming a single launch fixes a misaligned block wastes your limited attempts; verify every block position before triggering the flow.

ESTABLISHED: The boat moves left to core columns 26-28. Clicking specific blocks at row 21 clears passages above, allowing vertical ascent through the chimney structure. FAILED: Moving left without clearing the block at row 15 stops the boat under the intact upper section, preventing further rise. GOAL IS NOT: Reaching the absolute top row or clearing every block in the level immediately. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the boat horizontally. Mouse clicks destroy specific blocks to open vertical paths for ascent.

ESTABLISHED: Five pegs remain across two regions. The token sits at the doorway. FAILED: Clicking the token, moving it right, and attempting standard peg jumps into the corridor produced no result. GOAL IS NOT: Moving a peg into the third region via the corridor. CONTROLS: Clicking a peg initiates a jump; arrow keys move the token.

GOAL: Slide red bars to form a solid wall, then fill the sealed area with blue. CONTROLS: Click a bar to select it; arrow keys slide it horizontally; space confirms the solution. RULE: Only one bar can be active at a time, so you must click each bar individually to move it. TRAP: Assuming you can move all bars simultaneously or that clicking a bar doesn't deselect the previous one wastes time.

GOAL: Guide the tip to the head by navigating through a newly opened channel. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the tip one cell in the chosen direction. RULE: Bombing a red block turns it gray, creating a walkable path to the target. TRAP: Assuming destroyed blocks leave empty black voids instead of gray, traversable terrain.

ESTABLISHED: Pair one both dark moves down one. Pair two right dark grows. Pair three left dark rotates counter-clockwise. Pair two left and pair three right do nothing. FAILED: Treating grid positions as a keypad. Assuming horizontal and vertical channels act independently. GOAL IS NOT: A simple directional keypad or separate axis controls. CONTROLS: Darkening both elements in the first pair moves down. Darkening the right element of the second pair grows. Darkening the left element of the third pair rotates counter-clockwise.

GOAL: Advance the snake head permanently by blocking its tail home. CONTROLS: Arrows move the snake; SPACE toggles states and schedules a ghost block. RULE: Press SPACE in State A to schedule a ghost at your current spot, appearing after four moves. TRAP: Pressing SPACE in State B cancels the schedule instead of creating a ghost.

ESTABLISHED: Yellow clicks advance the platform. The dot stays on the platform when it moves. The platform is now wide enough to reach the right side. FAILED: Moving off the platform too early. Misreading the platform width due to the dot's position splitting the detection area. GOAL IS NOT: Simply standing on the yellow dot. The dot must be on the correct part of the yellow marker. CONTROLS: Yellow clicks move the platform right. Gray clicks change the phase. Arrow keys move the dot.

GOAL: Guide the tip to the pink socket and destroy the core. CONTROLS: Arrows move the block; clicks draw a line to launch the ghost. RULE: The ghost travels the drawn path; a blocked landing destroys the obstacle instead of moving the block. TRAP: Assuming a valid landing spot allows movement; here, the block stays put while the blocker breaks.

GOAL: Navigate the carrier through a narrow corridor to position it adjacent to the remaining peg for a final capture. CONTROLS: Use directional keys to move the carrier along the path; click the carrier to select, then click the marker to jump. RULE: A jump is only valid if the landing spot is an open white cell or the carrier’s current position. TRAP: Assuming corridor cells are always invalid landing spots; they become valid targets when occupied by the carrier.

GOAL: Guide the ring to the vault while coordinating two snakes and a timed ghost. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the ring; Space triggers a rewind to reset position and schedule a ghost. RULE: Pressing Space advances a snake’s head, clearing a path only after the ghost lands. TRAP: Ignoring the ghost’s landing delay causes collisions; you must wait for the snake to move before advancing.

GOAL: Move the plug upward into the cap to win. CONTROLS: Click dark toggles to activate hidden switches; use the mouse to execute the column's effect. RULE: Only the H0 and V2 switches matter; every column must be set to this pair to move the plug up one step. TRAP: Thinking you must keep the health bar alive; let it die to reset the board, then input the winning pattern.

ESTABLISHED: Five cores exist. The orange entity moves independently but cannot cross walls. Cores must be placed inside the wall structure for extraction. FAILED: Attempting to push cores along the bottom row is too slow. Trying to force the orange through walls fails. GOAL IS NOT: Simply collecting all cores in the player's inventory. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move and push. Space absorbs or drops cores. The orange acts on its own timer.

GOAL: Guide the plug through a narrow wall gap to reach the top-right cap. CONTROLS: Click grid cells to set move directions; right-click or drag to adjust path segments. RULE: The wall has a single gap at the middle height; path must pass exactly through it. TRAP: Assuming a straight path works; the plug gets stuck against the wall without a vertical detour.

GOAL: Clear the first level by moving the arm to capture the block using six directional presses. CONTROLS: Arrows extend or retract the arm; vertical moves drag blocks stuck to the arm into new rows. RULE: Blocks touching the arm’s previous position move with it when the arm shifts vertically. TRAP: Believing you can retract past a block to align it; collision stops movement if blocks overlap the path.

GOAL: Deliver two cores to the container using a shared timer. CONTROLS: Arrows move your avatar; every move also advances the orange helper. RULE: The orange acts independently on each of your turns, so idle moves still progress its task. TRAP: Assuming you must guide the orange directly wastes actions; instead, use harmless back-and-forth steps to wait for its autonomous completion.

GOAL: Guide the ring to the vault while two recorded ghosts block the path. CONTROLS: Arrows move the ring; Space records the current path and restarts the level. RULE: Each Space press adds a ghost; only two can exist at once, so the second press locks the first ghost in place. TRAP: Believing the first ghost vanishes when the second appears; it persists, so you must navigate around both.

GOAL: Capture all blocks using a telescoping arm. CONTROLS: Arrows move the head; the arm extends or retracts automatically with movement. RULE: Blocks are pushed only by newly revealed arm segments, not by existing coverage. TRAP: Assuming retraction drags blocks; it only frees them, requiring precise positioning before extending to push.
